body.name: theta
body.construction: For a transition \(U\) and a moment vector \(\zeta\) with coordinates \(m_k(\zeta)\) and \(C_k(\zeta)\), let \(T(U;\zeta)\) solve \(T-UTU^{\mathsf T}=C_0(\zeta)-C_1(\zeta)\), and define \[\theta(U,\zeta)=\bigl(\operatorname{vec}U,\operatorname{vec}(h^{-1}\operatorname{Log}U),\operatorname{vech}T(U;\zeta),\operatorname{vech}(C_0(\zeta)-T(U;\zeta)),(I_p-U)^{-1}(m_1(\zeta)-Um_0(\zeta)),m_0(\zeta)\bigr).\] Thus the last coordinate reconstructs \(\mu_0=m_0(\zeta)\).
